chunks: They said: "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will be stoned to death."

key_terms.الْمَرْجُومِينَ: The stoned (those who are stoned to death)
key_terms.نُوحٌ: Noah (peace be upon him), the prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Noah's people threaten to do if he did not stop preaching?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse from Surah Ash-Shu'ara underscores the persistent arrogance of Noah's people, who threatened him with stoning (rajm) to silence his call to monotheism. This threat illustrates the common pattern of disbelievers using physical intimidation against prophets, a theme echoed in the narratives of other prophets like Hud and Salih. The verse serves as a reminder that divine messengers often face severe social and physical persecution before ultimate vindication.
